OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: damage per shot
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The damage one shot does, all pellets counted. Under Combat Extended, with the ammo the gun is judged on.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: armor penetration
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How well a shot gets through armor. Under Combat Extended, the sharp penetration in mm of the ammo the gun is judged on.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: blunt penetration
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The blunt penetration in MPa of the ammo the gun is judged on.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: range
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How far the gun shoots, in cells.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: aim time
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: Seconds spent aiming before each shot or burst.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: shots per burst
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How many shots the gun fires each time it fires.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: cooldown
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: Seconds the gun waits after each shot or burst.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: accuracy (short)
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The chance to hit at short range.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: accuracy (medium)
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The chance to hit at medium range.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: accuracy (long)
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The chance to hit at long range.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: sights efficiency
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How much the gun's sights help aim.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: shot spread
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How far shots stray from where the gun aims.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: sway
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How much the gun moves while aiming.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: recoil
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How much each shot in a burst throws the next one off.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: magazine
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: Shots before the gun has to reload.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: reload time
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: Seconds to reload the gun.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: melee damage per second
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The weapon's average melee damage per second, as its info card gives it.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: melee armor penetration
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How well the weapon's attacks get through armor. Under Combat Extended, the attacks' sharp penetration in mm, by how often each is used, times the material's factor.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: mass
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: The weapon's mass in kg.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: bulk
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: How much room the weapon takes in Combat Extended's inventory.

OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.label: one-handed
OptimalLoadouts.WeaponOrders.WeaponNumbe.description: 1 for a weapon that leaves a hand free for a shield, 0 for one that doesn't.
